description: Synthetic SolTech sales mailbox and calendar. SolTech sells a PhilHealth-certified YAKAP EMR to Philippine clinics; product facts (YAKAP e-filing, Tranche 1/2, eKonsulta import, yearly plans by patient count, free 30-minute demo, Viber/Messenger support) are paraphrased from soltech.ph as of November 2026. Every person, clinic, address and link is invented (example.test). Covers: an inquiry -> reply -> booking thread, a multi-branch prospect, a Taglish inquiry with a non-ASCII name, an owner writing from California, mail the master must skip (draft, spam, newsletter, internal), Calendly bookings, an all-day onboarding visit, a weekly go-live series in Manila, a weekly series in Los Angeles that crosses the US daylight-saving change, internal and personal events the master must not ingest; scripted new mail, a deletion, a reschedule, two cancellations and a new booking from the new lead.

messages.subject: Inquiry: YAKAP EMR for our clinic in Imus
messages.body:
Good morning SolTech,

I run Reyes Family Clinic in Imus, Cavite. We are a YAKAP clinic with around 1,800 empaneled patients, and we still encode everything in eKonsulta after clinic hours. My staff and I are always rushing before the monthly cutoff.

A few questions:
1. How much is your EMR for a single clinic our size?
2. Can we bring over our existing patients and empanelments from eKonsulta?
3. Can my two staff have their own accounts?

Thank you,
Dr. Ana Reyes
Reyes Family Clinic

messages.subject: Re: Inquiry: YAKAP EMR for our clinic in Imus
messages.body:
Hi Dr. Reyes,

Thank you for reaching out! Answers to your questions:

1. With about 1,800 patients and one clinic, you fit our Basic plan (1 to 2,500 patients, single clinic). It is one fixed yearly subscription, currently PHP 50,000/year at our launch price. No onboarding, installation or performance fees, and your PhilHealth payout stays fully yours.
2. Yes. We can bulk-import your historical patients and active empanelments from eKonsulta, so you do not start from zero.
3. Yes, every staff member gets a personalized account.

The fastest way to see it is a free 30-minute demo, where we walk through YAKAP e-filing, Tranche 1 and Tranche 2 forms and the cutoff reminders. You can pick a time here: https://calendly.example.test/soltech/free-demo

Salamat po,
SolTech Sales Team

messages.subject: Multi-branch setup and pricing (3 clinics, Cebu)
messages.body:
Hello,

We are Northpoint Medical Clinic with three branches in Cebu (Mandaue, Lapu-Lapu and Talisay), about 6,000 YAKAP patients combined. We are looking for one EMR for all branches.

Can the owners see reports for all three clinics in one account, while each branch's staff only sees their own branch? And what would the pricing be for our size?

We prefer to coordinate on Viber if possible.

Regards,
Clinic Administrator
Northpoint Medical Clinic

messages.subject: Pagtatanong tungkol sa YAKAP EMR — Peña Pediatrics
messages.body:
Magandang araw po!

Pediatric clinic po kami sa Quezon City, YAKAP-accredited. Gabi-gabi po kami nag-e-encode ng consultations para humabol sa cutoff, kaya naghahanap po kami ng mas mabilis na system.

Tanong lang po:
- Gagana po ba kahit mahina minsan ang internet sa clinic?
- Kasama na po ba ang training para sa secretary ko?

Salamat po,
Dr. Jose Peña
Peña Pediatrics

messages.subject: EMR for my family's clinic in Iloilo (I'm based in California)
messages.body:
Hi SolTech,

My mother runs Villanueva Medical Clinic in Iloilo City, a YAKAP clinic with about 2,000 patients. I help manage it from California, so I need something cloud-based that I can check from here, and that her staff can learn quickly.

I booked a demo slot for December 3 in my time zone. Is that OK even though it is the next morning in Manila?

Thanks,
Carlo Villanueva
